normas.texto: Error messages must: (a) exist in the DOM as text (not only color or icon), (b) be linked to the offending input via aria-describedby, (c) use aria-invalid='true' on the input, (d) describe the error and how to fix it. Error summary at the top of the page is recommended for multi-field forms.
